data.revised_prompt:
Create a single horizontal pixel-art sprite strip for a digital pet named tracebun, using the provided reference/base pet as the exact identity model. Output one continuous row of 6 separate frames, left to right, with each frame containing the full character centered and fully visible, no cropping, no overlap between frames. The entire canvas background must be perfectly flat pure magenta #FF00FF edge-to-edge with absolutely no white, gray, checkerboard, borders, labels, dividers, guides, or slot lines.

Character identity: a compact observability-guardian rabbit with warm brown and cream fur, sturdy chibi silhouette, thick dark outline, small floppy ears, calm focused eyes, tiny service badge on the chest, and a dark brown engineer hoodie/vest with a yellow zipper pull and round badge. Preserve the exact head shape, ear shape, limb shape, face design, markings, palette, outline weight, body proportions, prop/accessory design, and overall silhouette from the reference. Do not redesign the pet. Only animate the waiting state subtly.

Animation: create a gentle waiting loop with slight idle changes only, such as tiny vertical bob, soft weight shift, minimal ear sway, subtle hand/arm position variation, and very small eye/face changes while keeping the character recognizable and nearly identical in every frame. No exaggerated motion. Distinct but restrained poses across 6 frames. Keep feet planted within each slot and maintain consistent scale and centering.

Style: clean retro game sprite, simplified pixel-art rendering, crisp silhouette, readable at small size, no extra props, no scene elements, no shadows outside the character, no glow, no motion blur, no text.
